description.content: List cases for the application, newest first. Supports filtering, search, and sorting; see query parameters. Paginated with `limit`/`offset`.

query.description: Page size. Defaults to 50.
Zero-based offset of the first record.
Comma-separated statuses to include, e.g. OPEN,AWAITING_USER.
Comma-separated priorities to include.
Comma-separated sources to include.
Filter to cases on this blueprint.
Filter to cases assigned to this user.
true for unassigned cases, false for assigned cases.
Filter to cases carrying this exact tag.
Matches title, case_number, tag, subject name/UUID/external ID, linked session UUID, or linked transaction UUID.
Created-at lower bound (inclusive).
Created-at upper bound (inclusive).
due_at upper bound.
true to return only overdue open/awaiting-user cases.
Sort order. due_at sorts nulls last.

description.content: Create a case anchored to exactly one subject (a user or a business), directly or by deriving the subject from an attached session/transaction link. Source is always `MANUAL` for API-created cases.

response.name: Case created.
Neither subject nor links provided, or the subject/blueprint/assignee was not found.

description.content: Retrieve a case with its subject, blueprint, notes, events, links, and checklist.

response.name: Case detail.
Case (or nested resource) not found in this application.

description.content: Update the case's title, priority, due date, or tags. Logs PRIORITY_CHANGED/DUE_DATE_CHANGED/TAG_ADDED/TAG_REMOVED events as applicable.

response.name: Updated case.

description.content: Soft-delete a case. There is no undelete endpoint; the row is retained internally for audit purposes only.
Assign the case to a user, or unassign it by sending assignee_user_id: null. assignee_email/assignee_name auto-provision a User row when the assignee does not exist yet.

response.name: Case assigned/unassigned.

description.content: Resolve the case as false_positive or valid_threat. Blocked with 400 if the blueprint's checklist is not optional and items remain incomplete, or if the blueprint requires a resolution note and none is given. When the case's blueprint has a four_eyes_checker_blueprint configured, the resolution is staged (case.pending_resolution) and the case moves to the checker blueprint instead of resolving immediately; a different user must call approve or reject-approval.

response.name: Resolved, or staged for 4-eyes approval.
Incomplete checklist items, or a resolution note is required.

description.content: Move an awaiting-user or resolved case back to open, clearing resolution, resolution_notes, resolved_at, and resolved_by_email.

response.name: Reopen case.

description.content: Move an open case to awaiting_user while more information is collected from the verified user. Fails with 400 if a resolution is currently pending 4-eyes approval.

response.name: Request info (awaiting user).

description.content: Move the case to its blueprint's configured escalation_blueprint. Requires the current blueprint to have escalation_enabled and an escalation_blueprint set, otherwise 400.

response.name: Escalate case.

description.content: Move the case to a different, active blueprint of the same application. Requires the current blueprint to have transfer_enabled, otherwise 400.

response.name: Case transferred.

description.content: Apply a resolution staged by resolve on a maker blueprint. The caller must be a different user than the one who submitted it, otherwise 403.

response.name: Resolution applied.
The caller is the same user who submitted the resolution (or the case has no recorded maker); a different officer must approve it.
Case has no resolution pending approval.

description.content: Reject a resolution staged by resolve and return the case to its maker blueprint. The caller must be a different user than the one who submitted it, otherwise 403.

response.name: Resolution rejected, case returned to the maker blueprint.
The caller is the same user who submitted the resolution (or the case has no recorded maker); a different officer must reject it.
Case has no resolution pending approval.

description.content: Act on the case's subject without leaving the case: set_status changes the user/business status, add_tags applies applicant tags, add_note posts an internal case note, and add_to_blocklist adds the subject's latest document and face to the blocklist. Logs an ENTITY_ACTION event.

response.name: Unsupported action, missing required field, or the case has no subject.

description.content: Render the full case (summary, subject, checklist state, notes, attached sessions/transactions, events, FIU report list) as a PDF and return a presigned download URL.
List notes on the case, newest first.

query.description: Page size.
Zero-based offset.

description.content: Post a plain-text note, optionally mentioning teammates, tagging it, or attaching files uploaded via notes/presign/.
Soft-delete a note.
Upload a file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, plain text, or CSV; max 5 MB) to attach to a note. Returns the s3_key to pass in the note's attachments array.
(Required)

response.name: No file, unsupported content type, or file exceeds 5 MB.

description.content: (Required)
Mint a fresh presigned download URL for an attachment already stored on one of the case's notes.

query.description: (Required) The attachment's s3_key, as returned by upload or listed on the note.

response.name: s3_key missing or does not belong to this case.

description.content: List sessions, business sessions, and transactions attached to the case.
Attach a session, business session, or transaction to the case. Rejected with 400 if the entity belongs to a different subject than the case.

response.name: Entity belongs to a different profile than the case subject.

description.content: Detach a linked session, business session, or transaction from the case.
Read-only audit timeline of the case (created, status changes, assignment, resolution, escalation, transfers, tag/priority/due-date changes, entity actions, and more).

query.description: Page size.
Zero-based offset.

description.content: List the case's checklist items, copied from the blueprint's content_config.checklist.items at creation, ordered.
Mark a checklist item complete or incomplete. Resolution is blocked while any item is incomplete, unless the blueprint marks the checklist optional.
List AML screening hits for the case's subject. Same shape as the hits returned by POST /v3/aml/.

Aggregate case analytics for the date range (defaults to the last 30 days; max 731 days): a created-vs-reviewed time series, per-officer/blueprint/source/status tables, rollup totals, and the live open/overdue queue depth.

query.description: Range start (inclusive). Defaults to 30 days ago.
Range end (inclusive). Defaults to today.

description.content: Apply the same status transition to several cases in one call: OPEN reopens, AWAITING_USER requests info, RESOLVED resolves (resolution required). Each case is evaluated independently; gate failures (incomplete checklist, missing required note) are reported per case without aborting the batch.
Assign (or unassign, with assignee_user_id: null) several cases at once. All cases must share the same blueprint; mismatches are reported per case without aborting the batch.
Identity verification API. Authenticate with x-api-key header.
